_doctrine: No workflow enters production without an entry here carrying a VERIFIED alternate platform. The alternate must be independently confirmed as permitted for the same data class by reading the ruleset cell, not by assuming symmetry. An alternate that is blocked for the workflow's data class is not an alternate; it is a note. The measure of success is that the alternate is already written down before anyone needs it.

schema.primary_model_version: EXACT version string, never a family name
schema.alternate_platform: platform id, verified permitted for the same data_class
schema.alternate_verified_date: ISO date the ruleset cell was actually read
schema.degradation_notes: what got worse on the alternate, not just whether it ran
schema.actual_swap_hours: number or null; fill in after any real event and correct the estimate
schema.revalidation_required: boolean; true for any GxP path
